title: Intel CEO Who Won Over Trump and Musk Now Needs a Breakthrough
title_zh: 赢得特朗普和马斯克支持的英特尔首席执行官现在需要突破
summary: (Bloomberg) -- After Lip-Bu Tan became chief executive officer of Intel Corp.
summary_zh: （彭博社）——陈立武 (Lip-Bu Tan) 出任英特尔公司首席执行官后

title: Mother's Day flowers to come with a bigger price tag this year
title_zh: 今年母亲节鲜花价格更高
summary: American families are expected to spend up to $38 billion on Mother's Day this year, according to the National Retail Federation (NRF), $3.2 billion of which will go toward buying flowers.
summary_zh: 根据美国零售联合会 (NRF) 的数据，今年美国家庭预计在母亲节花费高达 380 亿美元，其中 32 亿美元将用于购买鲜花。

title: Anthropic Inks $1.8 Billion Computing Deal With Akamai
title_zh: Anthropic 与 Akamai 签署价值 18 亿美元的计算交易
summary: (Bloomberg) -- Anthropic PBC has signed a $1.8 billion computing deal with cloud services provider Akamai Technologies Inc.
summary_zh: (彭博社) -- Anthropic PBC 与云服务提供商 Akamai Technologies Inc. 签署了价值 18 亿美元的计算协议。

title: Coinbase & Cloudflare's AI-driven layoffs might not be rewarded
title_zh: Coinbase 和 Cloudflare 人工智能驱动的裁员可能不会得到回报
summary: Cloudflare (NET) announced a round of layoffs, following Coinbase's (COIN) similar announcement at the beginning of the week.
summary_zh: 继 Coinbase (COIN) 于本周初发布类似声明后，Cloudflare (NET) 宣布了一轮裁员。

title: Intel stock hits fourth straight record high as Apple report fuels chip rally
title_zh: 苹果报告推动芯片反弹，英特尔股价连续第四次创历史新高
summary: Intel and Apple have reportedly reached a preliminary chip-making agreement.
summary_zh: 据报道，英特尔和苹果已达成初步芯片制造协议。

title: Are rising travel costs making 2026 the year of the staycation?
title_zh: 旅行成本的上涨是否会让 2026 年成为宅度假年？
summary: Consumers are keeping to a budget when planning this year's summer travel, taking into consideration the rising costs of airfare and surging gas prices (RB=F) in the US.
summary_zh: 考虑到美国机票价格上涨和汽油价格飙升 (RB=F)，消费者在计划今年夏季旅行时会严格控制预算。

title: Micron's monster run hits seventh straight record high
title_zh: 美光科技连续第七年创下历史新高
summary: Micron's AI memory rally is still running hot.
summary_zh: 美光的AI内存涨势依然火热。

title: Everything you need to know from the first 2 weeks of the Musk v. OpenAI trial
title_zh: Musk 诉 OpenAI 审判的前两周你需要知道的一切
summary: Elon Musk's lawsuit against one of the world's most valuable private companies has provided a number of details about the inner workings of OpenAI.
summary_zh: 埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 对世界上最有价值的私营公司之一提起的诉讼提供了有关 OpenAI 内部运作的大量细节。

title: University of Michigan sentiment data raises economic warning signs
title_zh: 密歇根大学情绪数据引发经济警告信号
summary: Yahoo Finance's Julie Hyman breaks down the University of Michigan consumer sentiment data and its effect on the economy.
summary_zh: 雅虎财经的朱莉·海曼详细分析了密歇根大学消费者信心数据及其对经济的影响。
